concerns.quote: IV fluids were not administered consistently. The longest period in which fluids were not administered was 17 hours and 45 minutes.
Contrary to Trust policy, fluid balance charts were not put in place to assess Mr [name redacted] fluid intake and output.
Clinical records were poorly maintained , resulting in an unclear picture of fluid administration.
Consultant-led ward rounds did not adequately review fluid monitoring.

links.explanation: Both reports highlight problems with intravenous fluid management in the trust, specifically failures to administer or monitor fluids appropriately.
links.earlier_quote: IV fluids were not administered consistently. The longest period in which fluids were not administered was 17 hours and 45 minutes.
links.later_quote: Intravenous fluids were commenced but these were not targeted against response. Christian remained hypotensive and tachycardic despite the fluid administration.
links.promise_quote: Cross site audits have been completed on COTE (Care of the Elderly) wards on a random basis to understand a cross section of compliance with fluid management with no notice given to the ward in advance of the audit. The audits capture patients who are on fluid restriction, patients requiring oral and intravenous hydration, parenteral nutrition and output monitoring, whether the intake and output is entered on Careflow Vitals and appropriate action taken as necessary.
